scenario: Longest-match tokenisation per LLEX.17.2 — multi-char operators (`->`, `**`, `//`, `<=`, `==`, `!=`, etc.) emit as whole tokens. Pin: `t.v ** 2 // 3 > 0` compiles, which `* *` or `/ /` read as two tokens would not. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: `compile_ok` reads no lowered output.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig t where t.v ** 2 // 3 > 0
->
    log info "x"
